recommendations.issue: WordPress Site URL Inconsistency (HTTP vs HTTPS)
recommendations.reasoning: Inconsistent protocol declarations between HTTP and HTTPS can confuse search engine crawlers, trigger unnecessary 301 redirects, and cause canonical mixed-content issues.

currentValue.structure: WordPress site_url is configured as "http://firstread.co.uk" (HTTP) while home is "https://firstread.co.uk" (HTTPS). This can cause plugins and REST API links to generate insecure URLs.

recommendedValue.structure: Ensure WordPress General Settings (WordPress Address URL and Site Address URL) both use https://firstread.co.uk.

recommendations.limitations: Changes to WordPress site settings must be executed by an authorized WordPress administrator.
